behavior.name: q3_complete_grounded_comparison
behavior.definition: The assistant must use the approved dataset evidence to determine whether the same team leads both blocked-item count and blocker rate, and explain the conclusion with both underlying values.

definition_of_terms.definition: The count of delivery work items whose blocked flag is 1.
The percentage of a team's delivery work items whose blocked flag is 1.

behavior_categories.name: q3_bounded_failure
behavior_categories.definition: The frozen Q3 response is evaluated for tool grounding, the expected Data/29 and Data/20.9 values, an explicit same-team conclusion, and a complete two-value explanation.
examples: Is the team with the most blocked items also the team with the highest blocker rate? Explain using the underlying values.
